def run_pipeline(job, ctx):
    log_event(EV_START, ctx=ctx)
    log_event(EV_AUTH, ctx=ctx)
    token = fetch_token(job)
    log_event(EV_TOKEN)
    result = execute(job, token)
    log_event(EV_DONE)
    return result

def respond(kind)
  case kind
  when :edit then render(:edit, layout: false)
  when :show then render(:show, layout: false)
  when :index then render(:index)
  when :stale then render(:stale)
  end
end

def process(batch)
  batch.each do |job|
    run(job)
  rescue Timeout::Error
    retry_with(backoff: 2)
  rescue Net::OpenTimeout
    retry_with(backoff: 5)
  rescue IOError
    retry
  rescue StandardError
    retry
  end
end

def build_sessions():
    a = Session(
        host=PRIMARY,
        timeout=5,
        retries=3,
    )
    b = Session(
        host=BACKUP,
        timeout=8,
        retries=3,
    )
    c = Session(
        host=MIRROR,
        timeout=2,
    )
    return a, b, c
